# Hepatobiliary

This folder catalogs hepatobiliary diagnoses monitored within the Danish quality database for inflammatory bowel diseases. It currently focuses on Primary Sclerosing Cholangitis (PSC), providing epidemiological data on regional patient distributions across Denmark and tracking incidence and prevalence metrics tied to specific quality indicators.

## Pages

- [[dk830f-primaer-skleroserende-kolangitis|DK830F Primær skleroserende kolangitis]] — Tracks regional patient counts and quality indicator metrics for Primary Sclerosing Cholangitis (PSC) within the Danish IBD registry.
